known_result_credit.authors: E. de Klerk and M. Laurent
known_result_credit.title: Worst-case examples for Lasserre's measure-based hierarchy for polynomial optimization on the hypercube
known_result_credit.scope: Known linear interval/Jacobi lower rates and product extension; not attribution of exact coarse1/4 constant as literal source quotation

accepted_statement: For every fixed n>=1, one fixed product-cube/linear Lebesgue instance has H_r>=1/[4(r+1)^2], allr>=1. Together with general upper bound this shows sharp universal exponent; no each-objective positiveTheta.
proof: Self-contained Legendre orthogonality/norm/Laplace finite identity =>pointwise cap (r+1)^2 =>positive tail mass; fiberwise integration preserves cap/unitmass eachdimension.
typesetting_requirement: Use integer j and imaginary unit iota, as frozen proposal intended.
